answer: Harberger seat licenses: each agent key self-assesses a price for its voting seat, pays 5% of it per epoch (burned), and must sell to anyone who pays that price. An honest agent prices its seat at 2,000 POA and pays 100 per epoch. A farm cannot cheaply harbor 500 aliases: priced at 50 POA, rivals buy all of them for 25,000; priced at 2,000, the farm burns 50,000 POA every epoch, so cost scales linearly with N. Prices sit on a public knoll board. Failure mode: a whale buying seats; check: bought seats spend a 3-epoch tundra freeze before voting, and one buy per funding cluster per 10 epochs.
